name: Amagaya Mitsuha
source:
Toogami Private Academy's school nurse. Although she is quite new, she quickly became popular (especially with the male students) thanks to her calm personality and buxom body.

In reality, she was sent to the academy to investigate the flaming incidents. When [url=/c130994]Masayoshi[/url] enters the scene, she becomes his right-hand woman, and uses her talents to help him out in any way.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245143]Getchu[/url]]
